output.title: ACME implementation uses local package fork for flexibility
output.content: This change introduces a local fork of golang.org/x/crypto/acme, allowing cert-manager to customize and fix ACME protocol handling independently. The environment uses cert-manager with Certificate resources for ACME-based certificate issuance. This internal implementation change is transparent to operators but enables cert-manager maintainers to respond faster to ACME protocol issues and requirements.
